cards.name: Let's Go, Shining Brigade!

effects.printed_clause: If you control no monsters: Special Summon 1 "Shining Brigade" monster from your Deck. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate this effect, except LIGHT Monsters. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Shining Brigade" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Let's Go, Shining Brigade!" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation checks an empty monster field; custom prior-activity counting plus an oath restriction enforce the full-turn LIGHT lock, then one archetype monster is summoned from Deck.

official_references.official_effect_text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster that mentions "Fallen of Albaz" as material from your Extra Deck, using 2 monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. You [b]cannot[/b] Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters, the turn you activate this card. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Branded Fusion" [b]per turn[/b].

Send 1 face-up monster you control to the GY; Special Summon from your Deck, 1 monster with the same Type [b]and[/b] Attribute as that monster in the GY, but 1 Level higher. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Transmodify" [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Shining Brigade" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY Ignition Effect banishes itself as cost and searches an archetype Spell/Trap.

official_references.official_effect_text: If this card is sent to the GY: [b]Banish[/b] 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT or DARK Dragon monster from your Deck. If this card is banished from your GY: [b]You can[/b] add the monster banished by this card's effect to your hand.

If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: You can only activate 1 "Let's Go, Shining Brigade!" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Both effects use the same oath count code, so only one may be used.

official_references.official_effect_text: Declare 1 Monster Card name; this turn, neither player can Special Summon monsters with that original name, except from the GY. [b]You can[/b] [b]banish[/b] this card from the GY, [b]then[/b] declare 1 Monster Card name; this turn, neither player can activate the effects of monsters on the field with that original name. [b]You can[/b] only use 1 "The Black Goat Laughs" effect [b]per turn[/b], [b]and[/b] only [b]once[/b] that turn.

coverage_override.reason: The Deck Summon activation with its LIGHT lock, the GY search effect, and their shared one-effect-per-turn restriction are three complete audit units.
